item.title: Royal Enfield upgrades the Himalayan 2019 with ABS and new color - “Sleet.”
item.description: Royal Enfield upgrades the Himalayan for 2019 with ABS and a new color offering - “Sleet.”The popular adventure touring model introduced last year in North America will now come standard with ABS and a new limited availability color Sleet. Dealers across the US and Canada will have the new 2019 Himalayan available this April in showrooms. The Himalayan motorcycle saw a strong debut in North America last year. item.title: Adventure Travel on a Budget: Five Tips to Travel Like a Boss
item.description: Your soul is ready to go ride around the world, but your bank account begs to differ? It’s more common than you think – but don’t despair. Adventure travel doesn’t need to be an expensive undertaking at all, as long as you’re willing to compromise (a little) and plan ahead (a lot). And no, adventure travel on a budget doesn’t mean sleeping in ditches and surviving on pot noodles – it just means a smarter way to ride around the world. 1.
